title: Contractor data ownership, return and removal need verified records
remediation: The contracting authority and sponsor data owner identify applicable suppliers and contract terms for ownership, the return deadline and removal from contractor systems. Verify a completed exit or approved exercise, reconcile the returned inventory with the original scope, and review the supplier removal evidence, backups, authorized retention and exceptions.

milestones.title: Collect signed ownership and exit clauses, a dated return receipt and reconciliation, and verified removal or authorized retention records
